name: Plow
overview: The Bible presents the plow both literally and figuratively, illustrating diligent labor and the experience of affliction. In 1 Samuel 13:20, the Israelites sharpened their plowshares with the help of Philistine smiths, highlighting practical preparation for farming. Elisha is found actively plowing with twelve yoke of oxen in 1 Kings 19:19, demonstrating the importance of faithful service before his prophetic calling. Job’s servants are also depicted plowing, showing everyday work amidst trials (Job 1:14). Psalm 129:3 uses plowing metaphorically to describe the deep suffering endured, portraying afflictions as furrows made by plowers upon the back.
